subject: NexaLabs vendor enrollment: PO exception & split-payment plan
messages:
From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela.ruiz@nexalabs.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@nexalabs.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment & PO setup for upcoming engagement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to get your team set up as a vendor so we can issue a standing PO for the next two quarters. A couple of questions from AP: 

• Do you accept split payments (50% on milestone / 50% on acceptance)? Nexa prefers this cadence for new vendors.
• Can you be registered under a US entity with the TIN on file? We need a vendor form and tax evidence.
• Our standard PO template has an invoicing contact (billing@) and requires a Remit To EFT routing. I’m attaching the PO template so you can confirm fields.

Could you please confirm next steps and any docs we should upload to your vendor portal? If easier, we can set a short call Monday.

Appended: Nexa_PO_Template.pdf (attachment)

Best,
Daniela
Daniela Ruiz
Procurement Lead, NexaLabs
Daniela.Ruiz@nexalabs.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela.ruiz@nexalabs.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & PO setup for upcoming engagement

Hi Daniela — great to hear. Thanks for the PO template, I reviewed it and added notes inline (see attached). Quick answers up front: 

• Split payments: we can accept a milestone / acceptance split for the first two engagements. We prefer invoices to reference the PO number and milestone identifier.
• Tax / TIN: we can be registered to Redwood Cloud Inc. (TIN ending in -1234). I’m attaching our W-9. For EU customers we provide VAT invoices; for US entities the W-9 should suffice.
• Remit/EFT: we’ll provide EFT routing and preferred remit email once finance validates the PO fields.

I’m looping in Laura (Finance) and Connor (Solutions) to confirm final routing and the onboarding artifact we’ll upload to Nexa’s portal. If you can send a portal invite link or vendor-code flow, that’ll speed things up.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf; Redwood_PO_comments.pdf

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 510-555-1234

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniela Ruiz <daniela.ruiz@nexalabs.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaLabs vendor enrollment: PO exception & split-payment plan

Marissa / Connor — Laura here from Finance. Thanks for the visibility, Daniela. A few operational notes so we can close the registration quickly: 

1) We can approve split-payment terms for the initial two POs. Please ensure each invoice contains: PO number, milestone tag (e.g., MS1, MS2), and acceptance sign-off reference. Without those fields, AP will auto-reject.

2) Remit information: I’ve attached our EFT/ACH remit stub that includes bank name, ABA, and account ending. We prefer electronic payments — specify "Remit To: Redwood Cloud Inc. / ACH" on the PO.

3) Tax evidence: W-9 received (thanks). Daniela — can you confirm whether Nexa needs Redwood's tax residence declaration or any additional vendor-self-cert forms? If so we’ll complete the vendor questionnaire and return.

4) Portal upload: If you provide a vendor portal link, we’ll upload Redwood_vendor_form_filled.pdf (completed) and the W-9. Otherwise we can accept a secure DocuSign flow for the vendor form.

Attachments: Redwood_EFT_remit_stub.txt, Redwood_W9.pdf

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Accounting Operations
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-2100

From: Daniela Ruiz <daniela.ruiz@nexalabs.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@nexalabs.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexaLabs vendor enrollment: PO exception & split-payment plan

Hi Laura / Marissa — thanks, this is perfect. Quick confirmations: 

• Nexus (AP) will accept the milestone tags you proposed (MS1 / MS2). We will include the payment schedule on each PO.
• I’ve created a vendor record in our portal and sent an invite to marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com — the portal requires the vendor form plus a bank verification (small deposit or Voided Cheque). If you prefer DocuSign instead, we can route the DocuSign powerform (link below).
• We do ask for a signed vendor self-cert for US tax residence for our records (one-page). I attached the portal link and the DocuSign powerform as options.

Portal link: https://vendor-portal.nexalabs.com/enroll?vendor_code=NX-RED-451
DocuSign powerform: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=1111&po=2222

I’ve attached the filled PO template with Nexa’s comments. Once you upload the vendor form and remit evidence we’ll issue the standing PO (PO # NX-PO-2028-0912).

Attachments: Nexa_PO_Template_filled.pdf

Best regards,
Daniela
